files.instructions: Your workspace folder is ${WORKSPACE_DIR}; always use full paths inside it. Layout: todo.md is the owner's to-do list (one '- [ ] task' per line; mark done as '- [x] task'). lists/<name>.md holds lists such as shopping or packing (one '- item' per line). notes/ holds the owner's free-form markdown notes. sessions/ holds your saved conversations with the owner (one .md file each): you may read them to recall an earlier conversation, but never write, edit, move or delete anything in sessions/. SYSTEM.md and agents/ hold your own instructions (the system prompt and the agents): change them only when the owner explicitly asks you to. Create a file or folder if it doesn't exist yet. To add to a list, prefer append_file over rewriting the file. When unsure where something is, list or search the folder first.
